name="jinjacho">[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4402075 Hatsuhime Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefectural Association of Shinto Shrines</ref> {{nihongo|'''Hatsuhime Shrine'''|初姫神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

== Overview ==
It is identified with '''Kanamura Iohomurahime no Mikoto Shrine''', a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}.<ref>On-site shrine history plaque</ref>

There are {{ill|Munafuda|Q8008834|qid=Q8008834}} (ridge tags) dating from {{ill|Bunroku|Q1373039|qid=Q1373039}} 5 (12th month), {{ill|Genna|Q635245|qid=Q635245|lt=Genna}} 3, {{ill|Jōō (Edo period)|Q1145081|qid=Q1145081}} 3, {{ill|Jōkyō|Q1146221|qid=Q1146221}} 4, and others.<ref name="jinjashi">Shizuoka Prefecture Shrine Gazetteer</ref>

In September {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} ({{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 6), it was ranked as a gōsha, and on June 21, {{ill|1907|Q2048|qid=Q2048}} (Meiji 40) it was designated a shrine authorized to receive offerings of sacred food and paper offerings from the state.<ref name="jinjashi"/>

== Enshrined deity ==
* Kanamura Iohomurahime no Mikoto
